assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: this program discusses going into space.
We talk about making long journeys into outer space, traveling well beyond our moon and the planets near us.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 我们谈论前往外太空的长途旅行，远远超出月球和附近行星。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: we're looking at the issue of space debris,
And what happens to all the things that people put into space?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 人们送入太空的所有物体后来会怎样？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: Humans first began to explore near space in 1957,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 人类1957年首次开始探索近地太空，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: when the Soviets sent the first human -made satellite,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 当时苏联将第一颗人造卫星，
斯普特尼克一号送入太空。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: the satellite stopped working and fell back to Earth.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 这颗卫星停止工作并落回地球。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: It didn't hit the ground because it burned up on the way to Earth.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 它没有落到地面，因为在返回地球途中烧毁了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: But when Karabi Sputnik one, or Sputnik four,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 但是当卡拉比·斯普特尼克一号，也就是斯普特尼克四号，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: a piece of it fell in the middle of a street in the central part of the U .S.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 它的一块碎片落在美国中部一条街的中央。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: there are many pieces of space junk from many countries going around the Earth and falling to Earth.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 现在，许多国家的太空垃圾碎片环绕地球并落向地球。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.text: This has many effects on our space programs and causes space accidents.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b969cee2d168cb3.zh: 这会给太空计划带来许多影响，也造成太空事故。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: Why is space junk a problem?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 为什么太空垃圾是个问题？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: the pieces of space junk travel at extremely fast speeds,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 太空垃圾碎片以极快速度飞行，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: over 25 ,000 km per hour,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 每小时超过25000公里，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: and so they can cause very bad problems if they hit anything.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 所以撞到任何东西都会造成严重问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: NASA,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 美国国家航空航天局，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: the U .S.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 美国的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: space agency,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 太空机构，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: watches where the space junk is.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 会监测太空垃圾的位置。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: The International Space Station,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 国际空间站，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: the ISS,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 即ISS，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: can move out of the way of the space junk if they get a message to move at least five hours before an accident.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 如果在事故前至少五小时收到移动通知，就能避开太空垃圾。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: Because people continue to send so many things into space,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 因为人们不断把许多东西送入太空，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: and this first started in 1957,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 而这从1957年就开始了，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: there are now over 27 ,000 pieces of space junk.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 现在已有超过27000块太空垃圾。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: The smaller pieces might be as tiny as a bit of paint,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 较小的碎片可能小得像一点油漆，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: but most of them are larger than ten cm across.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 但大多数直径超过十厘米。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: These are parts of old spacecraft,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 这些是旧航天器的部件，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: broken pieces of satellites,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 损坏的卫星碎片，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: and other things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 以及其他物品。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: Some of this happened because of accidents in space,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 其中一些来自太空事故，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.text: which can create thousands of pieces of space junk.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2aa204064aea56.zh: 事故能产生数千块太空垃圾。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: Many people would like to find a solution to space junk if they could.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 如果可能，很多人都希望找到解决太空垃圾的办法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: Scientists worry that if large pieces of space junk hit each other,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 科学家担心，如果大块太空垃圾相撞，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: they would break and there would be more and more broken pieces of space junk.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 它们会破碎，产生越来越多的太空垃圾碎片。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: When there is too much space junk,
we won't be able to use the space around the Earth for satellites.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 我们将无法利用地球周围空间部署卫星。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: So what options do we have to solve the problem?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 那么我们有哪些办法解决问题？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: is trying to solve the problem by catching space junk and taking it away.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 正试图通过捕获并移走太空垃圾解决问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: If all the space junk was gone,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.zh: 如果所有太空垃圾都消失，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_eba0b5415dc72e5.text: there wouldn't be a problem anymore.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: But what about space junk falling from space?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 但从太空落下来的垃圾呢？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: What is the danger to people?
There's not much chance anything would hit you if you were outside on a normal day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 如果在平常的一天里待在户外，几乎不可能有东西会撞到你。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: That's because most junk burns as it falls to Earth.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 这是因为大多数垃圾在坠向地球时都会燃烧掉。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: one person in the US was hit by a piece of space junk,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 美国有一人被一块太空垃圾击中，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: and she was not hurt at all.
a large piece of space junk from a SpaceX spacecraft fell to the surface of the Earth and landed on an Australian sheep farm.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 一块来自SpaceX航天器的大型太空垃圾落到地球表面，落在澳大利亚一座牧羊场。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: other large pieces hit the ground,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 其他大型碎片也会落地，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: most space agencies work to make their old spacecraft fall in the ocean if possible.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 大多数航天机构尽可能让旧航天器落入海洋。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.text: with tens of thousands of pieces of space junk,
there might be more than rain falling from the sky.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_69d3624f60d5e9e.zh: 从天而降的可能不止雨水。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: space exploration is important because we do research and get information about many things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 太空探索很重要，因为我们进行研究并获得许多信息。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: For example,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 例如，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: as scientists explore space,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 随着科学家探索太空，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: we learn about biology and about physics as well as space.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 我们了解生物学、物理学以及太空。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: So for me,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 所以对我而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: the most important thing is that governments give enough money for future exploration.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 最重要的是政府要为未来探索提供足够资金。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: You have a point that space exploration is used for a lot of scientific study,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 你说得有道理，太空探索用于许多科学研究，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: but it is very expensive and there is less public money to pay for it nowadays.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 但它非常昂贵，如今可用于支付的公共资金更少了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: Is having the government pay really the only option for paying for space exploration?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 由政府支付真的是唯一选择吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: I hear what you're saying, Dorota.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 我明白你的意思，多萝塔。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: It isn't cheap to run space programs,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 运行太空项目并不便宜，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: but the money we spend is certainly worth it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 但我们花的钱当然值得。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: Government and public money must be included.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 政府和公共资金必须包括在内。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: So far,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 到目前为止，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: space exploration has shown us many things about how space works,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 太空探索已经让我们知道太空如何运作，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: what stars do,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 恒星如何活动，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: the effects on people who stay in space for a long time and so on.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 长期待在太空对人的影响等等。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: We must continue to do this work so that we can explore places in space farther away and...
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 我们必须继续这项工作，才能探索更遥远的太空地点，而且……

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: Can I just say something here?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 我能在这里说一句吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: Yes, Raj.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 可以，拉吉。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: I agree 100 % with Dr Wu that we need space exploration,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 我百分之百同意吴博士，我们需要太空探索，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: but even he says it is very expensive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 但连他也说它很昂贵。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: I know that we have to spend money to develop our space programs
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 我知道我们必须花钱发展太空项目，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: and we need more money than governments have.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 而且需要比政府拥有的更多资金。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: So for me,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 所以对我而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: an alternative would be to bring in thinkers from different industries to discuss different ways to pay.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 另一种方法是邀请不同行业的思考者讨论不同筹资方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: If we are exploring space,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 如果我们探索太空，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: we could have private companies pay for it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 可以让私营公司支付。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: For me, this is the main reason we...
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 对我来说，这就是主要原因，我们……

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: But Raj,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 可是，拉吉，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: space exploration is so important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 太空探索如此重要。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: Governments must...
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 政府必须……

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: Sorry, Dr Wu, can I finish my point?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 抱歉，吴博士，我能讲完吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: If so much money is spent on space exploration,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 如果太空探索花了这么多钱，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: the most important thing should be finding money from places other than the government.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 最重要的是从政府以外的地方找资金。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.text: It shouldn't be just taxpayers paying for it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_167552fdb3ba146.zh: 不该只由纳税人支付。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Private companies make lots of money from the discoveries made in space exploration,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 私营公司从太空探索的发现中赚很多钱，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: so they should pay for the costs.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 所以它们应该承担费用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Dorota,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 多萝塔，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: you haven't said much so far.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 到目前为止你说得不多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Any thoughts?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 有什么想法吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Well, I personally don't see a problem.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 嗯，我个人看不出问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Dr Wu has a good point about public government money,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 吴博士关于政府公共资金说得有道理，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: and I feel exactly the same as Raj about private money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 我对私人资金的看法也和拉吉完全一样。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: But we can do both of these things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 但这两种方式都可以做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Public or government money helps us keep the people who know the most, like those at NASA,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 公共或政府资金帮助我们让最懂行的人，比如NASA的人，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: focused on the research,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 专注于研究，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: and private money helps bring in other talent from companies that would also like to explore space,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 私人资金则有助于吸引其他公司的人才，他们也想探索太空，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: such as Virgin Galactic or SpaceX.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 比如维珍银河或SpaceX。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Companies like these have already spent a lot of money on this important type of travel.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 这类公司已经在这种重要旅行上花了很多钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Yeah,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 是的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: important space travel that governments should...
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 这种重要的太空旅行，政府应该……

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Please, allow me to finish.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 请让我说完。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: There are also other choices that neither of you have talked about yet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 还有其他选择，你们两位还没有谈到。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Space exploration benefits the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 太空探索使世界受益。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: What about money from private individuals?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 私人个人出钱怎么样？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: There are wealthy people around the world that might be interested in giving money for these projects.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 世界上有富裕的人可能会对资助这些项目感兴趣。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Also,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: with the internet,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 有了互联网，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: people from around the world could give money for these projects.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 世界各地的人都可以为这些项目出钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Lots of people could make donations directly to their favourite projects.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 很多人可以直接向自己喜欢的项目捐款。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: I think in the future we can get money for space exploration from more than one place.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 我认为未来可以从不止一个地方获得太空探索资金。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: We should study these different ways and use the best solution.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 我们应该研究这些不同方式并采用最佳方案。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Dr Wu, Raj Paddow,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 吴博士、拉吉·帕多，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: let's get your thoughts on this.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 请谈谈你们对此的看法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Do you agree with these ideas for paying for space exploration?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 你们同意这些太空探索筹资想法吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Yes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 是的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Dorotta could be right.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 多萝塔可能是对的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: Space exploration needs money to come from many places,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 太空探索需要来自多处的资金，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: as long as the government is still a part of this important area of exploration.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 只要政府仍参与这一重要探索领域。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: And I think she might be right too,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 我也觉得她可能是对的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: but as I said,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 但正如我所说，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.text: only if there is money from private companies too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_487f5415fe96e13.zh: 前提是私营公司也出钱。
